title: Save StateGraph images to disk and reference file paths
description: Refactor graph visualization to save generated StateGraph images to disk instead of keeping them in memory. Update references to use file paths. This improves debugging and allows sharing graph visualizations outside runtime.

title: Externalize hardcoded trading configuration to env or database
description: Identify and refactor any hardcoded trading configuration dictionaries to use environment variables (via settings.py) or database configuration. The system already supports env-based config via dotenv. Review strategy/assembler.py, trading_graph.py, and backtest.py for hardcoded defaults that should be configurable.

title: Use with_structured_output in pattern_agent and trend_agent
description: Refactor pattern_agent.py and trend_agent.py to use LangChain's with_structured_output method for PatternReport and TrendReport respectively, matching the pattern already used in indicator_agent.py. This improves type safety and eliminates manual JSON parsing.

title: Mejorar retry logic con exponential backoff y multi-provider support
description:
Mejorar el sistema actual de retry (invoke_with_retry) en agent_utils.py para:
- Implementar exponential backoff real (actualmente usa wait fijo)
- Soportar errores de múltiples providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Qwen)
- Hacer configurable los parámetros de retry
- Considerar fallback a providers alternativos

Contexto: El sistema actual maneja RateLimitError de OpenAI con retry básico, pero puede mejorarse para ser más robusto y soportar otros providers de LLM.

Nivel: ESTÁNDAR

title: Fix tests expecting state updates across multi-agent calls
description: Update tests that call multiple agents and expect shared state to be updated. Tests should verify that analysis agents return structured reports (IndicatorReport, PatternReport, TrendReport) rather than modifying the messages state. Only Decision Agent should update messages.

title: Refactor Backtest to depend only on OrderManager (facade pattern)
description: Refactor the Backtest class to only depend on OrderManager instead of holding direct references to PositionSizer, RiskManager, and PaperBroker. OrderManager already acts as a facade for trading execution. This reduces coupling and improves encapsulation. The Backtest class should interact with trading components exclusively through OrderManager's interface.

title: Position reversal fails when switching from SHORT to LONG due to size mismatch
description:
When the trading system has a SHORT position and needs to switch to LONG, the order manager calculates the new position size based on current price and risk, but this causes a mismatch with the existing position size that needs to be closed first.

Error: "Trying to buy 0.0342770443640196 shares but SHORT position in BTC is only 0.0330943811250786"

The system generates a signal and fills the order, but then fails on portfolio update, leaving the system in an inconsistent state (signal generated but position not properly reversed).

Root cause: Position reversal should be handled as two operations:
1. Close existing SHORT position (0.0330943811250786)
2. Open new LONG position (calculated size)

But the system treats it as a single operation with freshly calculated size.

title: Fix message management across agent calls
description: Verify and fix that the add_messages annotation function in agent_state.py works properly across multi-agent graph execution. Ensure analysis agents (indicator, pattern, trend) do NOT add messages to shared state, while Decision Agent does. See docs/03_design/MESSAGE_STATE_MANAGEMENT.md for the intended design.

title: Backtest Market Hours Filtering
description: Add market-hours-aware time period generation to backtesting engine to skip analysis during non-trading periods for traditional assets (stocks, indices, futures), while preserving 24/7 behavior for crypto assets. This will reduce unnecessary agent executions and token costs.
